messages:
Elise K.: Hey team — quick Qs for my last week. My official last day is Mon 2024-05-13. What should I expect for benefits/COBRA timing, laptop return, VPN/Okta access removal, and any visa paperwork I need to handle? Thanks in advance.

Sophia (People Ops): Hi @Elise K., thanks for the heads-up and sorry to see you go. High level: COBRA offer will be sent after termination, coverage is effective up to your last day (Mon 5/13) unless you elect COBRA to continue. VPN/Okta deprovision happens EOD on your last day. We need you for a short exit interview — can you do Tue 2024-05-14 at 10:00am? I will DM the COBRA packet and next steps.

Elise K.: Tue 10am works. Quick payroll/equity Qs: when do I get the final paycheck and how is PTO/equity handled?

Maya (Payroll): Final paycheck goes out on the next pay run: Fri 2024-05-17. PTO payout follows policy (prorated). Equity: unvested options stop vesting at termination; vested options remain per your grant terms. I'll send a short summary to you and @Sophia with dates and amounts.

Oliver - IT: For hardware: we can arrange an overnight UPS pickup to your home. Please ship by Fri 5/17 so we can reprovision the device. Laptop return label & instructions once People Ops confirms. Note: Okta/VPN/Sys access will be revoked at EOD on Mon 5/13. If you need limited access after, manager + security approval required.

Elise K.: Will laptop be collected before COBRA paperwork is processed? Also, anything I need to sign for device wipe or KMS key rotation?

Sophia (People Ops): COBRA is independent of device return — benefits timeline is unaffected by hardware. We rotate KMS/HSM access after device receipt; no additional signature needed from you for key rotation. Just confirm receipt of the courier when it arrives so we can close the asset ticket. Also please remove personal files and sign out of personal apps before shipping.

PeopleOps Bot: Offboarding form submitted by Elise K. (ID: 98765). Next step: People Ops will confirm courier label and pickup window. Reminder: schedule exit interview (assigned to Sophia).

Elise K.: Visa: I have J-1 paperwork — who do I contact for an employment verification or neutral employer letter? My visa advisor asked for a termination/verification letter.

Sophia (People Ops): Ping @Legal (Anna) and I'll coordinate. Legal can prepare a neutral employment verification letter; if you want an advisory intro to an immigration attorney we work with locally, I can share contacts.

Oliver - IT: Quick tech reminders: remove personal SSH keys from company projects, transfer repo ownership where you're the only admin, and make sure any personal tokens are deleted. If you prefer, list the repos and we'll reassign. Example command to list local public key fingerprint:```ssh-keygen -lf ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub```

Elise K.: I'll run a repo sweep today and DM the list. Do I need to export Slack messages or anything?

Sophia (People Ops): You can export your personal notes before deprovision. Company records are retained per retention policy. If there are specific threads you want preserved, export them now and DM me which to keep.

Maya (Payroll): COBRA forms will be emailed within 14 days of termination. You have 60 days from the date of the COBRA notice to elect coverage; premiums are retroactive to the termination date. Include dependents if applicable.

Elise K.: Great, thanks. Is there a short checklist I should follow to make sure nothing slips? I'll also update my manager's handoff doc.

Sophia (People Ops): Short checklist: 1) Offboard form (looks like you already submitted it) 2) Decide on COBRA within 60 days after notice 3) Exit interview — Tue 5/14 10:00am with People Ops 4) Ship laptop (label pending; we will schedule Fri 5/17 pickup) 5) Reassign repos and revoke personal tokens 6) Confirm final pay/PTO with @Maya 7) Legal/visa letter — DM me so I can loop in legal. I'll post confirmed pickup label/tracking once booked. :handshake:

Oliver - IT: Pickup tentatively scheduled for Fri 2024-05-17 AM window. We'll DM the UPS tracking number when the label is printed (tracking format: 1Z...). Also please make sure any external device creds (AWS MFA, personal SSH) are removed or handed off.

Jordan (Manager): Thanks for wrapping things up, Elise. I'll review the handoff doc today and we can do a short overlap with the team on Thu so it's smooth.

Elise K.: Thanks everyone — appreciate the clear timeline. I'll finish the repo sweep and look out for the courier label. :slightly_smiling_face:
